# Review AI-search visibility

Use Peec only after the recipient chooses a project and access is verified. Read the current prompt set, dates, channels and market. Save raw responses and reports with their scope. Separate mentions, citations and share-of-voice measures from website visits or business outcomes. Small samples are not market-wide conclusions. Read cited answers where useful, compare like periods and recommend a concrete investigation. Do not change tracked prompts or schedules without approval.
